Every detail

Fought 3 times: Moss Mother (Ruined Chapel), 120 health; Moss Mother (Moss Grotto, Act 3), only black-threaded: 700 health; Moss Mother (Weavenest Atla), 350 health and 700 black-threaded, in Act 3.

With the Needle alone (a Hunter's Crest with no Tools or modifiers), with the Needle, Sharpened Needle, Shining Needle, Hivesteel Needle and Pale Steel Needle: Moss Mother (Ruined Chapel): 24, 14, 10, 8 and 6 slashes; Moss Mother (Weavenest Atla): 59, 39, 30, 25 and 21 slashes.

With the Hunter's Crest, a slash every 0.41 s (the game's own pace, from its files): with the Pale Steel Needle, 2.1 s of nonstop slashing.

Attacks, as the wiki names them (the game doesn't): Swoop, Headbutt.

Staggered after 11 hits.

Phases, from the game's own files: Moss Mother (Ruined Chapel): phase 2 at 114 health (95%); Moss Mother (Weavenest Atla): phase 2 at 332 health (95%).

Reward: Weavelight.

This page opens the damage calculator with this boss picked: with your save or your build, each of your attacks' damage, how many it takes, and what each of its attacks does to you.

Questions

What is Moss Mother's health in Silksong?

Fought 3 times: Moss Mother (Ruined Chapel), 120 health; Moss Mother (Moss Grotto, Act 3), only black-threaded: 700 health; Moss Mother (Weavenest Atla), 350 health and 700 black-threaded, in Act 3.

How many hits does it take to beat Moss Mother?

It depends on your Needle and your Tools: with the Needle alone, from 24 slashes with the Needle to 6 with the Pale Steel Needle. For your exact build, open the calculator on this page.
